items.name: North America
items.hint: North of the Panama isthmus: Canada, the United States, Mexico and Central America.

items.name: South America
items.hint: South east of Panama, widest in the north and tapering to Cape Horn.

items.name: Australia
items.hint: Between the Indian and Pacific oceans, south of Indonesia.

items.name: Europe
items.hint: West of the Ural Mountains and north of the Mediterranean.

items.name: Antarctica
items.hint: The polar landmass south of the Antarctic Circle.

items.name: Asia
items.hint: East of the Urals and the Red Sea. The largest continent.

items.name: Africa
items.hint: South of the Mediterranean, straddling the Equator.

items.name: Atlantic Ocean
items.hint: Between the Americas to the west and Europe and Africa to the east.

items.name: Pacific Ocean
items.hint: The largest ocean. Asia and Australia to the west, the Americas to the east.

items.name: Indian Ocean
items.hint: South of Asia, east of Africa, west of Australia.

items.name: Arctic Ocean
items.hint: Over the North Pole, ringed by North America, Europe and Asia.

items.name: North Sea
items.hint: Between Great Britain and Norway, Denmark, Germany and the Netherlands.

items.name: Baltic Sea
items.hint: North east of Germany and Poland, enclosed by Sweden, Finland and the Baltic states.

items.name: English Channel
items.hint: The narrow water between southern England and northern France.

items.name: Norwegian Sea
items.hint: Off the west coast of Norway, between Iceland and Scandinavia.

items.name: Barents Sea
items.hint: North of Norway and north west Russia, inside the Arctic Circle.

items.name: Mediterranean Sea
items.hint: Between southern Europe, north Africa and the Middle East.

items.name: Adriatic Sea
items.hint: Between Italy and the Balkan coast, north of Greece.

items.name: Aegean Sea
items.hint: Between Greece and Turkey, north of Crete.

items.name: Black Sea
items.hint: North of Turkey, joined to the Mediterranean through the Bosporus.

items.name: Caspian Sea
items.hint: Landlocked, east of the Caucasus, between Russia and Iran.

items.name: Great Lakes
items.hint: Five connected lakes on the border of the United States and Canada.

items.name: Red Sea
items.hint: Between north east Africa and the Arabian Peninsula.

items.name: Persian Gulf
items.hint: Between Arabia and Iran, north west of the Arabian Sea.

items.name: Arabian Sea
items.hint: Between the Arabian Peninsula and India.

items.name: Bay of Bengal
items.hint: East of India, west of Myanmar, north of the Indian Ocean.

items.name: South China Sea
items.hint: South of China, east of Vietnam, west of the Philippines.

items.name: East China Sea
items.hint: Between China and the southern Japanese islands, north of Taiwan.

items.name: Yellow Sea
items.hint: Between eastern China and the Korean Peninsula.

items.name: Sea of Japan
items.hint: Between Japan and the Korean Peninsula and the Russian coast.

items.name: Nile River
items.hint: Flows north through Sudan and Egypt to the Mediterranean. The longest river in Africa.

items.name: Amazon River
items.hint: Crosses northern Brazil from west to east into the Atlantic.

items.name: Mississippi River
items.hint: Runs south through the central United States to the Gulf of Mexico.

items.name: Rio Grande
items.hint: Forms much of the border between Texas and Mexico.

items.name: Indus River
items.hint: Flows south west through Pakistan to the Arabian Sea.

items.name: Ganges River
items.hint: Flows east across northern India into the Bay of Bengal.

items.name: Danube River
items.hint: Runs east from southern Germany through central Europe to the Black Sea.

items.name: Yangtze River
items.hint: Crosses central China from west to east. The longest river in Asia.

items.name: Yellow River
items.hint: Loops through northern China to the coast, north of the Yangtze.

items.name: Tigris River
items.hint: Flows south east through Iraq, on the eastern side of the pair.

items.name: Euphrates River
items.hint: Flows south east through Syria and Iraq, on the western side of the pair.

items.name: Alaska Range
items.hint: Arcs across southern Alaska. Contains Denali.

items.name: Rocky Mountains
items.hint: Runs down western North America from Canada to New Mexico.

items.name: Appalachian Mountains
items.hint: Runs along eastern North America from Alabama up into Canada.

items.name: Andes Mountains
items.hint: Runs the length of western South America. The longest range on land.

items.name: Alps
items.hint: Arcs across south central Europe from France to Austria.

items.name: Atlas Mountains
items.hint: Crosses Morocco, Algeria and Tunisia, north of the Sahara.

items.name: Ural Mountains
items.hint: Runs north to south through Russia. The boundary of Europe and Asia.

items.name: Hindu Kush
items.hint: Between Afghanistan and Pakistan, west of the Himalaya.

items.name: Himalaya Mountains
items.hint: Arcs along the northern edge of India. Contains Everest.

items.name: Atacama Desert
items.hint: A narrow coastal desert in northern Chile, west of the Andes.

items.name: Sahara Desert
items.hint: Spans northern Africa. The largest hot desert.

items.name: Gobi Desert
items.hint: Across southern Mongolia and northern China.

items.name: Kalahari Desert
items.hint: Across Botswana and into Namibia and South Africa.

items.name: Namib Desert
items.hint: A coastal strip along Namibia on the Atlantic side.

items.name: Syrian Desert
items.hint: Across Syria, Jordan and western Iraq.

items.name: Great Sandy Desert
items.hint: In north western Australia, inland from the coast.

items.name: Arctic Circle
items.hint: 66.5 deg N. Above it the sun does not set at midsummer.

items.name: Tropic of Cancer
items.hint: 23.5 deg N. The northern limit of the overhead sun.

items.name: Equator
items.hint: 0 deg latitude, midway between the poles.

items.name: Tropic of Capricorn
items.hint: 23.5 deg S. The southern limit of the overhead sun.

items.name: Antarctic Circle
items.hint: 66.5 deg S, just off the Antarctic coast.

items.name: Prime Meridian
items.hint: 0 deg longitude, running through Greenwich in London.

items.name: International Date Line
items.hint: Near 180 deg longitude, where the calendar date changes.
